```plato
//==
// # Numbers
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Extended-number arithmetic
//  - Dual-number arithmetic (forward-mode automatic differentiation)
//  - Modified Bessel functions I0 and I1
//  - Beta and regularized incomplete beta
//  - Error function and complement
//  - Gamma and log-gamma
//  - Regularized incomplete gamma functions

library Numbers
{
    //==
    // # Extended-number arithmetic
    //
    // Operator and interface obligations for the types of `numbers.types.plato`: Complex
    // (full INumerical plus ComplexÃ—Complex product/quotient), Rational (IComparable
    // plus field arithmetic), and the unitless constrained scalars Proportion /
    // Percent / Probability (INumerical + IComparable on their carrier).

    //==
    // Complex â€” INumerical obligations and complex field arithmetic.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Complex_number

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(a: Complex, b: Complex): Complex
        => (a.Real + b.Real, a.Imaginary + b.Imaginary);

    // Component-wise difference.
    Subtract(a: Complex, b: Complex): Complex
        => (a.Real - b.Real, a.Imaginary - b.Imaginary);

    // IAdditive inverse.
    Negative(z: Complex): Complex
        => (-z.Real, -z.Imaginary);

    // Complex product: (a+bi)(c+di) = (ac-bd) + (ad+bc)i.
    Multiply(a: Complex, b: Complex): Complex
        => (a.Real * b.Real - a.Imaginary * b.Imaginary,
            a.Real * b.Imaginary + a.Imaginary * b.Real);

    // Scale both parts by a real factor.
    Multiply(z: Complex, scalar: Number): Complex
        => (z.Real * scalar, z.Imaginary * scalar);

    // Complex quotient. Precondition: b is non-zero.
    Divide(a: Complex, b: Complex): Complex {
        var denom = b.Real * b.Real + b.Imaginary * b.Imaginary;
        return ((a.Real * b.Real + a.Imaginary * b.Imaginary) / denom,
                (a.Imaginary * b.Real - a.Real * b.Imaginary) / denom);
    }

    // Divide both parts by a real factor. Precondition: scalar is non-zero.
    Divide(z: Complex, scalar: Number): Complex
        => (z.Real / scalar, z.Imaginary / scalar);

    // Component-wise remainder against a real factor.
    Modulo(z: Complex, scalar: Number): Complex
        => (z.Real.Modulo(scalar), z.Imaginary.Modulo(scalar));

    // Linear interpolation of both parts; t is unclamped.
    Lerp(a: Complex, b: Complex, t: Number): Complex
        => (a.Real + (b.Real - a.Real) * t,
            a.Imaginary + (b.Imaginary - a.Imaginary) * t);

    // The additive identity: 0 + 0i.
    Zero(_: Complex): Complex
        => (0.0, 0.0);

    // The multiplicative unit: 1 + 0i.
    One(_: Complex): Complex
        => (1.0, 0.0);

    // Component-wise least representable value.
    MinValue(_: Complex): Complex
        => (Number.MinValue, Number.MinValue);

    // Component-wise greatest representable value.
    MaxValue(_: Complex): Complex
        => (Number.MaxValue, Number.MaxValue);

    //==
    // Rational â€” exact ratio arithmetic and order.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rational_number
    // Results are not reduced; callers that need a canonical form should
    // divide out the GCD separately when that helper exists.

    // a/b + c/d = (ad + bc) / (bd). Precondition: neither denominator is zero.
    Add(a: Rational, b: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(
            a.Numerator * b.Denominator + b.Numerator * a.Denominator,
            a.Denominator * b.Denominator);

    // a/b - c/d = (ad - bc) / (bd). Precondition: neither denominator is zero.
    Subtract(a: Rational, b: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(
            a.Numerator * b.Denominator - b.Numerator * a.Denominator,
            a.Denominator * b.Denominator);

    // IAdditive inverse: -a/b.
    Negative(r: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(-r.Numerator, r.Denominator);

    // (a/b)(c/d) = (ac)/(bd). Precondition: neither denominator is zero.
    Multiply(a: Rational, b: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(a.Numerator * b.Numerator, a.Denominator * b.Denominator);

    // (a/b) / (c/d) = (ad)/(bc). Precondition: neither denominator is zero,
    // and b's numerator is non-zero.
    Divide(a: Rational, b: Rational): Rational
        => new Rational(a.Numerator * b.Denominator, a.Denominator * b.Numerator);

    // Cross-multiply order, accounting for the sign of the product of
    // denominators so negative denominators do not reverse the relation.
    LessThanOrEquals(a: Rational, b: Rational): Boolean {
        var left = a.Numerator * b.Denominator;
        var right = b.Numerator * a.Denominator;
        return a.Denominator * b.Denominator >= 0
            ? left <= right
            : left >= right;
    }

    //==
    // Proportion â€” unitless scalar in [0, 1]; INumerical + IComparable on IValue.

    Add(a: Proportion, b: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(a.Value + b.Value);

    Subtract(a: Proportion, b: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(a.Value - b.Value);

    Negative(x: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(-x.Value);

    Multiply(x: Proportion, scalar: Number): Proportion
        => new Proportion(x.Value * scalar);

    Divide(x: Proportion, scalar: Number): Proportion
        => new Proportion(x.Value / scalar);

    Modulo(x: Proportion, scalar: Number): Proportion
        => new Proportion(x.Value.Modulo(scalar));

    Lerp(a: Proportion, b: Proportion, t: Number): Proportion
        => new Proportion(a.Value + (b.Value - a.Value) * t);

    Zero(_: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(0.0);

    One(_: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(1.0);

    MinValue(_: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(Number.MinValue);

    MaxValue(_: Proportion): Proportion
        => new Proportion(Number.MaxValue);
```
